title: Function card
responsibility: Shows a linked helper invocation or service name and a smaller Used In row linking up to three consumers.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The helper or service at the viewed revision, including its recorded name and up to three consumer links.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation that retains branch and commit when opening the helper, service or consumer.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: A linked helper invocation or service name and smaller Used In row. Up to three consumer links retain revision scope; absent consumers show a dash.
